airport_records.name: Fort Lauderdale–Hollywood International
airport_records.location_note: FLL, distinct from Miami/MIA. Contemporary Delta airport-code page 260 identifies Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International. Broward County records document the existing airport terminal expansion during 1985–1987. Approximate airfield coordinates, not reconstructed 1986 gates, runway thresholds or aircraft positions.

airport_records.name: Fort Myers–Southwest Florida Regional (1986)
airport_records.location_note: The contemporary Delta code table on page 261 assigns RSW to Fort Myers Regional. This airfield opened in May 1983; Page Field/FMY is a different airport. Historical 1986 Regional name retained; the newer terminal opened in 2005. Approximate airfield coordinates, not reconstructed 1986 gates, runway thresholds or aircraft positions.

airport_records.name: Jacksonville International
airport_records.location_note: The contemporary Delta code table on page 260 identifies Jacksonville International. Airport authority history establishes the current airport opened in 1968, replacing Imeson; Imeson is not used. Approximate airfield coordinates, not reconstructed 1986 gates, runway thresholds or aircraft positions.

airport_records.name: Orlando International
airport_records.location_note: MCO identified as Orlando International on contemporary Delta page 261. Airport authority history describes international status/name in 1976 and the 1981 terminal complex; separate Orlando Executive/ORL is not used. Approximate airfield coordinates, not reconstructed 1986 gates, runway thresholds or aircraft positions.

airport_records.name: West Palm Beach–Palm Beach International (1986)
airport_records.location_note: PBI and International are printed for West Palm Beach on Delta page 261. Historical 1986 PBI code/name retained despite the current coordinate record using a later name/code. Airport history describes 1966 and 1974 terminals on this airfield; the 1988 terminal is not represented. Approximate airfield coordinates, not reconstructed 1986 gates, runway thresholds or aircraft positions.
